truth_boundary: This study answers the Visual QA handoff after Nature PR #9 migrated the already-proven tapered-cap winding repair into source generation. It rebuilds the exact Map PR #15 multi-asset scene, then compares the historical PR #8 rear-tree mesh with the source-generated PR #9 rear-tree mesh under the same target-only backface-culling state while every unrelated Map, Building, Nature, Weather, Object, path, camera, lighting and proof-material dependency remains fixed. Other source Nature meshes remain culling-disabled so their historical topology cannot confound this rear-tree comparison. A PASS can establish only that the migrated rear-tree source reaches the exact receiving scene and changes the retained target-host image under the declared culling review without changing its vertices or triangle membership. It does not establish global outward-normal correctness, final leaf/backface representation, final vegetation materials, deformation/wind quality, target-device runtime budgets, collision/navigation/gameplay, CANON, production readiness or Environment/Nature mastery.
